facts.text: The orange open movie project presents.
Introductory titles are showing.
The background is a water pool.
Fishes are swimming in the water pool.
Mechanical objects are lying on a stone floor.
The title 'elephants dream' appears.
Two people stand on a small bridge.
The old man is Proog.
The younger and less experienced man is Emo.
Proog shoves Emo on the ground.
Proog saves Emo from being mowed down by a barrage of jack plugs.
The jack plugs whir back and forth.
The jack plugs move between two massive switch-board-like walls.
The plugs are oblivious of the two.
The plugs endlessly channel streams of bizarre sounds.
The plugs endlessly channel streams of data.
Emo sits on the bridge.
Emo checks his limbs.
The squealing plugs move on.
Proog makes sure that Emo is unharmed.
Proog urges Emo onwards through a crack in one of the plug-walls.
They walk through the narrow hall.
They enter a massive room.
The room fades away into blackness on all sides.
Only one path is visible.
The path is suspended in mid-air.
The path runs between thousands of dangling electric cables.
Crowds of robin-like robotic birds sit on the cables.
Proog and Emo enter the room.
The birds begin to wake up.
The birds notice Proog and Emo.
Proog realizes the danger.
Proog grabs Emo by the arm.
Proog and Emo run along the path.
The path is increasingly bizarre.
The birds begin to swarm.
All sound is blocked out by the birds.
The birds are making the same noises as the jack-plugs.
The birds are making garbled screaming.
The birds are making obscure sentences.
The birds are making static.
The path dead-ends.
The path stops in the middle of nowhere.
The path is above the infinite drop.
Proog turns around.
The birds reach Proog and Emo.
The birds begin to dive-bomb at Proog and Emo.
At the last moment, Proog takes out an old candlestick phone.
The birds dive into the speaker piece.
The screen cuts to black.
In the next scene, Proog stands at one end of a room.
Proog is suspiciously watching what is probably the same candlestick phone.
The candlestick phone is ringing.
Emo watches from the other side of the room.
The phone continues to ring.
After a while Emo approaches the phone to answer it.
Proog slaps Emo's hand away.
Proog takes the ear-piece off the hook.
The phone speaker revealed a mass of clawed, fleshy polyps.
The polyps scream.
The polyps gibber obscenely.
There is a solemn silence.
Emo looks around the room.
Emo looks around the technical objects therein.
Emo laughs disbelievingly.
Proog walks away.
In the next scene, the two enter another massive black room.
There is no path.
The entry platform is the only structure that seems to be there.
Another exit is lit distantly at the far side.
Proog takes a step forward into the void.
Proog's feet are suddenly caught by giant typewriter arms.
The giant typewriter arms rocket up out of the blackness.
The giant typewriter arms catch Proog's feet as he dances across mid-air.
Emo follows Proog with somewhat less enthusiasm.
The older man leads the way.
They reach the end of the room.
They go through a hall.
They go into a small compartment.
Proog presses a button.
The door shuts.
It is an elevator.
The elevator lurches suddenly.
The elevator is grabbed by a giant mechanical arm.
The elevator is thrown upwards.
The elevator rushes up through an ever-widening tunnel.
The elevator begins to slow down.
Another arm grabs the capsule.
Another arm throws the capsule even further up.
The elevator moves up.
The walls unlock.
The walls fall away.
Only the floor with the two on it is left.
The floor rushes higher and higher.
They exit the tunnel into a black sky.
The platform reaches the peak of its arc.
The elevator begins to drop down another shaft.
The elevator comes to rest.
The elevator slams into the floor of another room.
The elevator brings the two to a level stop.
A camera flashes.
They are in a large room.
The room is dingy.
The room is filled with strange, generator-like devices.
The room is dotted with boxy holographic projectors.
One of the holographic projectors is projecting a portion of wall with a door in it right beside them.
The door seems harmless enough.
From behind the door comes light music.
Proog presses a button on his cane.
The button press changes the holograph to another wall.
Proog finishes the wall.
Proog boxes them into a Safe Room.
The Safe Room is out of the view of anything outside.
Proog slaps Emo.
Proog tries to bring Emo to his senses.
Emo storms away down the length of the room.
Emo moves towards a wall he apparently cannot see.
The wall begins to move.
The wall extends the length of the room.
The walls begin to discolour.
Mechanical roots start tearing through the walls to his left.
The roots move forwards toward Proog.
The rest of the safety wall crumples away.
A pair of massive hands heave out of the ground.
The massive hands begin to attack.
Proog is knocked down by the shockwave.
Emo turns.
Emo begins to walk away.
Emo waves his finger around his temple in the 'crazy' sign.
In a last effort, Proog extricates himself from the tentacle roots.
Proog cracks Emo over the back of the head with his cane.
Emo collapses.
Everything falls away.
Proog and Emo are left in one tiny patch of light in the middle of blackness.
The scene fades to black.
The scene pans over a pile of tentacle roots lying on the ground.
The credits begin.

Titles appear under the rippling water.
The rippling water floods a grungy tile floor.
On-screen text reads: 'the orange open movie project presents'
On-screen text reads: 'elephants dream'
An old man's face is reflected in the water.
The old man looks up.
The old man shoves young Emo to the floor of a bridge.
A flurry of thick black cables zips by.
The cables plug themselves into banks of sockets.
Banks of sockets line the walls of a steel chasm.
The ever-changing web of cables moves on.
Emo is dirty and gaunt.
Emo considers.
Proog is balding and stooped with sideburns and a beak-like nose.
Proog, the old man, leads them off the bridge.
Proog pulls Emo through a slit in the wall.
They enter a dark, cavernous space.
The space is filled with cables transmitting bolts of light.
A suspended path of rectangular panels crosses the immense room.
They run along the winding path.
On the overhead wires, small robotic birds take notice.
The small robotic birds begin to fly about.
One of the panels flips when Proog steps on it.
The panel flipping forces Proog to run on the underside of the path.
Emo continues along the top.
Proog defies gravity beneath Emo.
More panels flip.
The pair keeps running whether right-side up or upside down.
The path abruptly ends.
The two men slide to a stop.
Several birds lift off of their wires.
The birds swoop down on them.
Everything turns black.
A red carpet lies on the floor of a small, dark room.
A single light shines down on an old-fashioned telephone.
The light is above the red carpet.
Emo reaches out to answer the telephone.
Proog slaps Emo's hand.
The earpiece is full of carnivorous plants.
The projection of a rotary telephone ticks away like a wall clock.
A typewriter robot taps at its keypad.
The typewriter robot is in the corner.
Proog picks up a sharp walking stick.
Proog leads Emo out of the room.
A small duck-like robot swims through the air.
The small duck-like robot emerges from a drainpipe.
The two men proceed along a short plank.
The short plank extends into a vast, dark space.
Proog tosses his walking stick.
Proog steps off the plank.
Robotic arms rise up to meet Proog's feet.
The two men cross the void using the robotic arms like intuitive stepping stones.
Proog dances.
Proog kicks his legs.
Proog waves his arms.
Emo walks calmly behind Proog.
An arm whacks the duck-like robot.
The two men reach the other side.
They step into a small room.
The room has walls resembling mottled marble.
The doors slide shut.
Proog presses a red button.
The room lurches.
They are inside an elevator capsule.
A giant metal arm hurls the capsule up a massive shaft.
Jagged steel doors shut behind them like mechanical sphincters.
A robotic bird pecks at a scrap of metal up above.
The capsule whips by into the grip of another giant arm.
They are launched further up the shaft.
The capsule breaks apart.
Proog and Emo are left on a fast-moving platform.
Proog watches the walls of the shaft whip by.
The platform rises into a concave land dotted with steel towers.
They descend down another shaft.
The platform lands on a narrow bridge.
Wires tumble in glass drums beneath their feet.
Movie projectors with legs lumber along beside them.
Proog finds his walking stick.
A door is projected onto the wall.
Proog presses a button on his walking stick.
The space changes.
They stand in a small, tiled room.
Proog grits his teeth.
Proog slaps Emo.
Emo strides off.
The room extends to allow it.
Giant metal worms appear.
They break down the walls.
Proog covers his face.
Giant hands rise up behind Proog.
Proog dives to the ground.
Proog avoids the giant hands' grip.
Emo shrugs.
Emo turns to leave.
Proog grabs his walking stick.
Proog leaps up.
Proog clubs Emo over the head.
Emo collapses.
The giant hands wither and fall.
The metal worms wither and fall.
Proog kneels beside Emo's body.
Proog hangs his head.
Emo's hand lies motionless atop the tangle of lifeless metal worms.
